Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: A client project or collaboration inquiry submitted through the portfolio contact form.

authorId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user who submitted the inquiry.

name.description: Full name or organization of the prospective client.

email.description: Email address of the prospective client.

projectType.description: Selected service pillar or inquiry focus.

message.description: Detailed project summary, timeline, and editorial goals.

status.description: Workflow state of the inquiry (closed is terminal).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was last updated.

PortfolioItem.title: PortfolioItem
PortfolioItem.description: A dynamic portfolio case study or published article managed in Firestore.

authorId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the admin who created the item.

title.description: Title of the case study or published piece.

summary.description: Concise summary of the project and editorial approach.

impactMetric.description: Key business or editorial outcome achieved.

externalUrl.description: URL to the live article or study.

published.description: Whether the item is publicly visible on the portfolio.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator registry document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Stores client project inquiries with PII isolation so only the inquiry author or an admin can read/manage them.

/portfolioItems/{itemId}.description: Stores dynamic portfolio items managed by the admin and publicly readable when published is true.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores verified administrator UIDs for role-based access control.
